description: Cryptominium measures, every day, what a fixed-size sell of each tracked token actually returns versus its quoted price, by querying live DEX routing on Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain. Use this when someone asks whether a token can really be sold, how liquid it is, or what they would get for a position. Returns the latest measured exit friction (% lost to price impact), the dollars received, the date measured, and a citation — plus, where the token trades on Kraken or Coinbase, what the same sell loses against those order books, and this week's changes as short tags with the 7-day high, low and latest price. Not a price feed and not advice.
